Returns & Refund Policy

Last updated: February 17, 2026 • Effective from: February 17, 2026

Quick Summary: Most products can be returned within 7 days of delivery. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after approval. Contact support@69shop.in for any return or refund queries.

1. Return Eligibility

Products purchased on 69Shop.in are eligible for return under the following conditions:

  • Return request is raised within 7 days of delivery
  • The product is unused, unworn, and in its original packaging
  • All tags, labels, and accessories are intact
  • The product is not damaged by the customer
  • Proof of purchase (order confirmation email or order ID) is available

2. Non-Returnable Products

The following categories are not eligible for return unless defective or damaged on arrival:

  • Perishable goods (groceries, fresh food items)
  • Personal hygiene products (undergarments, swimwear)
  • Beauty products that have been opened or used
  • Customised or personalised items
  • Digital products and downloadable software
  • Gift cards and vouchers
  • Products marked as "Non-Returnable" on the listing page

3. Valid Return Reasons

ReasonEligible for ReturnEligible for Refund
Defective or damaged productYesFull refund
Wrong product deliveredYesFull refund + free return shipping
Product not as describedYesFull refund
Missing parts or accessoriesYesFull refund or replacement
Wrong size or colourYesExchange or store credit
Changed mind / no longer neededYes (within 7 days)Refund minus return shipping
Quality not as expectedYesRefund after inspection

4. How to Request a Return

  1. Go to your Profile and find the order under "My Orders"
  2. Click "Return/Exchange" on the item you wish to return
  3. Select the reason for return from the dropdown
  4. Upload photos of the product (required for defective/damaged claims)
  5. Choose your preferred resolution: Refund, Replacement, or Store Credit
  6. Submit the return request
  7. You will receive a confirmation email with your RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) number

Alternatively, email support@69shop.in with your order ID, reason, and photos.

5. Return Process

  1. Request submitted: Your return request is logged and an RMA number is generated
  2. Seller review: The seller reviews the request within 1-2 business days
  3. Approval/Rejection: Seller approves or provides a reason for rejection
  4. Return shipping: If approved, you will receive return shipping instructions. For defective/wrong items, a prepaid return label may be provided
  5. Package inspection: The seller inspects the returned item within 2 business days of receipt
  6. Resolution: Refund, replacement, or store credit is processed

6. Return Shipping

  • Defective / Wrong product: Return shipping is free (paid by 69Shop.in or the seller)
  • Change of mind: Return shipping cost is borne by the buyer
  • Packaging: Products must be returned in their original packaging. If original packaging is unavailable, use secure packaging to prevent transit damage
  • Tracking: Always use a tracked shipping method. 69Shop.in is not responsible for items lost during return transit without tracking

7. Refund Policy

Refund methods:

Original Payment MethodRefund MethodRefund Timeline
UPI / Net BankingOriginal payment source5-7 business days
Credit / Debit CardOriginal card5-10 business days
Cash on Delivery (COD)Bank transfer (NEFT/IMPS)7-10 business days
Store Credit69Shop.in wallet1-2 business days

Partial refunds may be issued if the product shows signs of use, missing tags, or the return does not meet all eligibility criteria.

8. Exchanges

  • Exchanges are subject to product availability
  • If the replacement product costs more, you will need to pay the difference
  • If it costs less, the difference will be refunded
  • Exchanges follow the same return process outlined above

9. Cancellations

  • Before shipment: Orders can be cancelled for a full refund at no charge
  • After shipment: You must wait for delivery and then initiate a return
  • How to cancel: Go to your profile, find the order, and click "Cancel Order", or email support@69shop.in

10. Seller Disputes

If you disagree with a seller's decision on your return request:

  1. Contact support@69shop.in with your RMA number and details
  2. Our support team will mediate between you and the seller
  3. 69Shop.in reserves the right to make a final decision on disputed returns
  4. Decisions will be communicated within 5 business days

11. Contact

For return or refund queries:

  • Email: support@69shop.in
  • Website: https://69shop.in
